portfolio.introduction: Hi! I'm a Full-Stack developer with experience in frontend, backend, and databases. Check out the projects I have worked on!
portfolio.kernelciIntro: Within ProFusion mobi, I worked on the KernelCI Dashboard project. KernelCI is an open source project helping Linux Kernel developers build and test their code, and they need a dashboard to visualize all the results.
portfolio.kernelciResponsibilities: I worked on the frontend, backend and database, as well as CI/CD, unit and integration tests, email notifications, and performance monitoring. I was also the development team leader for a while.
portfolio.kernelciFeaturesPages: New pages and <featuresLink>multiple features</featuresLink> with React;
portfolio.kernelciFeaturesPerformance: Query performance improvements of <performanceLink>more than 10x</performanceLink> on some pages;
portfolio.kernelciFeaturesCicd: <cicdLink>CI/CD/CT</cicdLink> with GitHub Actions, increasing <coverageLink>backend coverage</coverageLink> to 70%;
portfolio.kernelciCeremonies: Scrum and Kanban ceremonies and meetings with international clients.
portfolio.kernelciTechnologies: Technologies used: React, TypeScript, Django, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Scrum, Kanban, cron jobs, Prometheus, Jinja.
portfolio.kernelciRepository: You can find KernelCI Dashboard's repository at
portfolio.websiteDescription: I've made everything in this website myself and with some help from AI agents, from design to implementation and deployment. This is a personal portfolio website built with Next.js, it showcases my projects, experience, and skills as a developer.
portfolio.websiteTechnologies: Technologies used: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, AI agents.
portfolio.websiteRepository: You can find this website's repository at
portfolio.hydroponicDescription: In university, I learned about distributed systems and one of the topics was multiple microcontrollers installed in a hydroponic garden for environment control. I made the frontend in Dart, connecting to a backend in Java, that received data from a microcontroller in C++.
portfolio.hydroponicDetails: The frontend was made with Flutter and we used an ActiveMQ AWS broker as the medium between all components.
portfolio.hydroponicTechnologies: Technologies used: Flutter, Dart, ActiveMQ, AWS.
portfolio.hydroponicRepository: You can find the frontend's repository at
portfolio.portfolioPlatformTitle: Website to create and share portfolios
portfolio.portfolioPlatformDescription: With a colleague, I made the frontend of a web platform having CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functionality for projects and users. This would allow users to create and share their own portfolios.
portfolio.portfolioPlatformDetails: The frontend was made with Next.js and it connected to a Java backend.
portfolio.portfolioPlatformTechnologies: Technologies used: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs.
